dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple elliptical and circular 'O' shaped structures are visible in the central lateral region, exhibiting sharp gradient transitions from dark perimeter pixels to high-intensity light tan interiors with clearly defined geometric edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, asymmetrical high-intensity white clusters is concentrated on the anterior dorsal region (head and neck), while larger, more isolated light clusters are distributed along the posterior lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the mid-section form an acute triangular relationship, with a secondary cluster of four smaller annuli forming a trapezoidal spatial arrangement further back on the flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Four dark, vertically oriented linear indentations are visible in a parallel sequence along the mid-lateral line, appearing as distinct textural interruptions in the skin surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The rostrum and crown areas exhibit a unique high-frequency 'stardust' pattern consisting of micro-scale high-intensity pixels that differ in morphology from the larger lateral macro-annuli.
